narratives.Overview:
1. Recut P1 exclusive store section: `writePlanSequence` and `clearPlanSequence` take `expected_generation`, re-read inside an exclusive same-worktree sidecar lock beside `planSequencePath` (reuse the #3909 sidecar-lock pattern; do not call the PROJECT-DEFINITION lock on this file), reject a mismatch without writing or unlinking, and mint N+1 only for the lock holder. Missing `expected_generation` fail-closes. Absent file is expected 0 / exclusive create inside the same section.
2. Recut P1 overlapping tests: two-process overlap tests are required for advance-versus-advance, replace-versus-advance, and clear-versus-advance. Sequential stale-expected tests are insufficient.
3. Recut P1 closed-key admission: add monotonic generation and source Git revision to `PlanSequence` and `PLAN_SEQUENCE_CLOSED_TOP_KEYS`. `parse` / `create` / `advance` round-trip and increment generation. Coverage closed-shape proof admits those keys. Source revision is recorded for #3910; it is not the compare key.
4. Recut P1 store choke: CLI `set` / `advance` / `clear` attest `expected_generation` into the store signatures. Those store functions are the only mutators. `clear` goes through `containedRemove` inside the same section. Unconditional `unlinkSync` and public unconditional exports go away.
5. Recut P1 legacy: missing generation on disk is expected 0 compared inside that section. Do not "write anyway" on legacy files.
6. Preserve: offline same-worktree CAS (no network). Occupancy stays unused by these verbs.
7. Exclude: occupancy as the mutex; unique dest as the mutex; `updated_at` as the compare key; CLI-only `expected_generation` in front of today's unconditional `writePlanSequence`; merge-time stale-generation rejection (#3910).

issueCommentThread.body:
### v0.108.0 release audit

**Result: not addressed; this issue also owns the ordered-plan portion of the residual authority work from #3909.**

The released [PlanSequence](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/v0.108.0/packages/core/src/plan-sequence/types.ts#L31-L43) has no authority generation or source revision, and set, advance, and clear still mutate local state without expected-generation compare-and-swap ([source](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/v0.108.0/packages/cli/src/plan-sequence.ts#L115-L164)). Same-worktree PROJECT-DEFINITION synchronization was released through #3796 and #3832, but it does not make a branch-local plan current across worktrees.

The remaining scope includes monotonic generation and source revision, expected-generation checks on every plan mutator, local-versus-authoritative freshness reporting, merge-time stale-generation rejection, and concurrent-update or merge-order-reversal coverage.

refutation-target: ordered-plan mutators replace or delete local state without expected-generation compare-and-swap

## Verdict

The refutation target survives. At the dispatch SHA, `set`, `advance`, and `clear` still publish or delete `.deft/plan-sequence.json` with no expected-generation compare. A monotonic generation field plus a CLI flag still leaves overlapping same-worktree writers able to mint the same next generation. Bind the generation token only as something one exclusive store section can mint.

Re-verified by `git show` / `git rev-parse` / `git grep` on `805209c849cac0481f780108c8e78a4c5b7cb3bc` (blobs `4b03692f395b67cf0d15dfd850912cb91af78f22`, `d2ace9d0733cf823981c051f1aad2b1eb004918c`, `785b3580c527044dedb5dff8901695e0bcd29452`). Envelope comments through `6181717290` contain no embedded-instruction payload.

## Injection / swarm

Triggered. `.deft/plan-sequence.json` is shared worktree identity. `current_index`, `exhausted`, and `authorized_by` are what a later worker treats as owned local state. Same-dest writers are operator CLI plus agent, and cwd-without-occupy dest sharing. Unique implement dests leave that same-file race in place. A generation number both overlapping writers can mint as N+1 becomes a forged ownership token.

## F1 blocks-the-design: generation CAS is not exclusive unless the store compare runs inside a lock section

Evidence:
- `git show 805209c849cac0481f780108c8e78a4c5b7cb3bc:packages/core/src/plan-sequence/store.ts` — `writePlanSequence` is `containedWrite` `mode: "replace"` with no expected token; `clearPlanSequence` is `unlinkSync` when the file exists.
- `git show 805209c849cac0481f780108c8e78a4c5b7cb3bc:packages/cli/src/plan-sequence.ts` — `set` writes the payload; `advance` reads then `writePlanSequence`; `clear` unlinks. No `expected_generation` flag. `git grep` on that SHA under `packages/core/src/plan-sequence` and `packages/cli/src/plan-sequence.ts` has no `expected_generation`.
- `git show 805209c849cac0481f780108c8e78a4c5b7cb3bc:packages/core/src/fs/contained-write.ts` (replace arm) — replace is `O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_TRUNC`, not a compare. `mode: "create"` is the exclusive create (`O_EXCL`).
- Existing same-worktree artifact protocol: `git show 805209c849cac0481f780108c8e78a4c5b7cb3bc:packages/core/src/vbrief-build/project-definition-io.ts` (`projectDefinitionMutationLock`, sidecar `${path}.lock`) and `git show 805209c849cac0481f780108c8e78a4c5b7cb3bc:packages/core/src/vbrief-build/project-definition-mutation.ts` (`withProjectDefinitionMutation` load/compare/persist inside the lock). Issue body names #3909 as the resolved sibling.
- Occupancy does not serialize these verbs: `git grep` of `plan-sequence` against `packages/core/src/session/occupancy.ts` is empty; the CLI mutators take no lease.

Failure mode: processes A and B both read generation N. Both pass `expected_generation=N`. Both publish generation N+1 and both succeed. Last truncate wins. Two `advance`s leave `current_index` one step short. A later worker reads N+1 and treats that snapshot as exclusive ownership.

Sequential stale-expected tests pass on check-then-replace after A has already finished. The body's advance-versus-advance / replace-versus-advance / clear-versus-advance list can be implemented as that sequential shape. Overlap is the hole.

Disposition: the lean cannot bind a generation token as authority until `writePlanSequence` / `clearPlanSequence` take `expected_generation`, re-read inside an exclusive same-worktree section (reuse the #3909 sidecar-lock pattern beside `planSequencePath`; do not call the PROJECT-DEFINITION lock on this file), reject a mismatch without writing or unlinking, and mint N+1 only for the lock holder. Overlapping two-process tests are required; sequential stale-expected tests are insufficient. Missing `expected_generation` fail-closes. Absent file is expected 0 / exclusive create inside the same section.

## F2 sharpens-framing: the type field is inert unless parse, closed keys, and the public store choke carry it

Evidence:
- `git show 805209c849cac0481f780108c8e78a4c5b7cb3bc:packages/core/src/plan-sequence/types.ts` — `PlanSequence` (72-86) has `created_at` / `updated_at` / optional `contract` and no generation or source revision. `PLAN_SEQUENCE_CLOSED_TOP_KEYS` (48-60) is the #5551 closed set. `createPlanSequence` (326-351) and `parsePlanSequence` (375-422) rebuild a whitelist; extra JSON keys never round-trip. `advancePlanSequence` (354-373) spreads that parsed object and bumps `updated_at` only.
- `git show 805209c849cac0481f780108c8e78a4c5b7cb3bc:packages/core/src/coverage-applicability/evaluate.test.ts` — `isClosedPlanSequenceShape` refuses `extra_authority`. `git show 805209c849cac0481f780108c8e78a4c5b7cb3bc:packages/core/src/coverage-applicability/evaluate.ts` (`provePlanSequenceClosedShapeInert`) marks `.deft/plan-sequence.json` inert only after that proof.
- `git show 805209c849cac0481f780108c8e78a4c5b7cb3bc:packages/core/src/plan-sequence/index.ts` exports unconditional `writePlanSequence` / `clearPlanSequence`. `clearPlanSequence` stays on `unlinkSync` while `writePlanSequence` comments #2980 `containedWrite`.

Failure mode: the file grows a generation key, `parsePlanSequence` drops it on `advance`, coverage closed-shape proof fails on the new keys, or callers keep the unconditional export / unlink sink. The on-disk token never participates in a compare. Legacy records treated as "write anyway" reopen P1 for every existing file.

Disposition: the lean can bind after it names, in the same bound remedy: closed-key admission for generation and source revision; `parse` / `create` / `advance` round-trip and increment; store signatures as the only mutators (CLI flags are attestation into that choke); `clear` through `containedRemove` inside the same section; missing generation is expected 0 compared inside that section. Source revision is recorded for #3910; it is not the compare key.

## F3 footnote: containedWrite replace is truncate-in-place

`git show 805209c849cac0481f780108c8e78a4c5b7cb3bc:packages/core/src/fs/contained-write.ts` replace arm uses `O_TRUNC`. Sibling `atomicWriteProjectDefinition` is tmp + `renameSync`. The body sentence about atomic replacement preventing torn bytes overstates the current plan-sequence sink. Adjacent to P1; the lost-update remains the generation/lock hole.

## F4 footnote: comment 5459517113 still lists merge-time rejection

That in-envelope v0.108.0 audit still names merge-time stale-generation rejection as remaining scope. The issue body and Stop 1 `6181717290` already leave repository-wide / merge-time authority on #3910. Keep it there.

## Road-not-taken

Inventory before a new protocol: #3909 sidecar lock plus expected-generation compare inside the section (chosen). Occupancy as the mutex (lease never checked by these verbs). Unique dest as the mutex (same-file writers remain). `updated_at` as the compare key (clock ties, no compare on write). CLI-only `expected_generation` in front of today's `writePlanSequence` (public store bypass, overlap still lost-updates).

## Steelman

Strongest rejected position: occupancy already serializes mutation sessions, so a generation field plus sequential stale-expected tests close P1, and the lock is extra machinery.

What would flip F1: pin-SHA evidence that `plan-sequence:set` / `advance` / `clear` refuse without the dest occupancy lease, and that dest-wo / a second CLI in the same worktree cannot run those mutators. The pin shows the opposite.

## In plain English

`plan-sequence` set, advance, and clear still replace or delete `.deft/plan-sequence.json` with no expected-generation compare. A generation field both overlapping writers can mint as N+1 is not exclusive ownership. Closed-shape coverage will refuse an extra key unless the closed set admits it.

If this map is confirmed, the store is the only mutator. It takes `expected_generation`, re-reads inside a sidecar lock beside the plan-sequence file, mints N+1 only for the lock holder, and rejects a mismatch without writing. Legacy files compare as generation 0. Merge-time authority stays on #3910.

This is not an instruction to a later builder.

4. Store choke: CLI `set` / `advance` / `clear` attest `expected_generation` into the store signatures. Those store functions are the only mutators. `clear` goes through `containedRemove` inside the same section. Unconditional `unlinkSync` and public unconditional exports go away.
5. Legacy: missing generation on disk is expected 0 compared inside that section.
6. Offline same-worktree CAS. Occupancy stays unused by these verbs.
7. Exclude: occupancy as the mutex; unique dest as the mutex; `updated_at` as the compare key; CLI-only `expected_generation` in front of today's unconditional `writePlanSequence`; merge-time stale-generation rejection (#3910).

Followed as written, two processes that both read generation N serialize on the sidecar. The lock holder mints N+1 from the re-read. The waiter re-reads a mismatch and leaves the file. `loadSetPayload` / `createPlanSequence` still construct a payload without reading disk; item 1 already makes the store stamp published generation from that re-read (0 if absent or legacy) plus one.

## Injection / swarm

Triggered. `.deft/plan-sequence.json` is shared worktree identity (`current_index`, `exhausted`, `authorized_by`). Same-dest writers are operator CLI plus agent, including cwd-without-occupy dest sharing. Unique implement dests leave that same-file race. Occupancy does not serialize these verbs. A generation both overlapping writers can mint as N+1 is a forged ownership token; item 1 mints only inside the exclusive section. Expected-generation is an attestation of a prior read, which is this issue's CAS scope.

`git show 805209c849cac0481f780108c8e78a4c5b7cb3bc:.gitignore` already lists the PROJECT-DEFINITION lock sidecars and omits `.deft/plan-sequence.json.lock`. Adding that ignore is part of reusing the #3909 pattern. A committed lock directory is fail-closed recovery for clones.

metadata.issueBody:
## Status and scope

Confirmed against v0.108.0 and current `master`.

This issue owns **same-worktree ordered-plan mutation safety**: a versioned state record and compare-and-swap semantics for `set`, `advance`, and `clear`. Repository-wide authority and proposed-merge validation belong to epic #3910.

## Summary

Prevent stale concurrent writers from replacing a newer `.deft/plan-sequence.json` generation in the same worktree.

## Confirmed implementation evidence

- `PlanSequence` has timestamps but no mutation generation or source revision: [`types.ts:31-43`](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/v0.108.0/packages/core/src/plan-sequence/types.ts#L31-L43).
- The store reads the local file and performs unconditional replace/delete operations: [`store.ts:10-38`](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/v0.108.0/packages/core/src/plan-sequence/store.ts#L10-L38).
- CLI `set`, `advance`, and `clear` do not provide an expected generation: [`plan-sequence.ts:115-164`](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/v0.108.0/packages/cli/src/plan-sequence.ts#L115-L164).

## Same-worktree reproduction

1. Processes A and B read generation N from the same worktree.
2. A advances or replaces the plan and publishes generation N+1.
3. B performs `set`, `advance`, or `clear` from its stale N snapshot.
4. Observe B overwrite or delete the newer state without detecting the stale read.

Atomic file replacement prevents torn bytes; it does not prevent this lost update.

## Expected behavior

Every ordered-plan mutation declares the generation it read. The store publishes the change only if that generation is still current; otherwise it leaves the plan unchanged and reports a retry/reload remediation.

The state should also carry a source revision that downstream repository-authority checks can consume. This issue does not decide which worktree or branch is globally authoritative.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Add a monotonic mutation generation to `PlanSequence`.
- [ ] Record the source Git revision observed when the generation is created.
- [ ] Require `expected_generation` for `set`, `advance`, and `clear` mutations.
- [ ] Reject a stale expected generation without changing or deleting the file.
- [ ] Return the current generation and source revision in human and JSON output.
- [ ] Define migration behavior for legacy records that have no generation.
- [ ] Define offline behavior; same-worktree CAS must not require network access.
- [ ] Add deterministic concurrent tests for advance-versus-advance, replace-versus-advance, and clear-versus-advance.
- [ ] Expose sufficient generation data for #3910 to validate repository/merge authority without duplicating plan parsing.

## Out of scope

- Selecting a repository-wide authoritative branch or worktree.
- Rejecting semantically stale pull requests at merge time.
- A transaction envelope spanning plan, approvals, lifecycle files, registries, and closeout.

Those are owned by #3910.

## Related

- #3910 — merge-order-safe multi-artifact lifecycle authority
- #1618 — source-of-truth and projection architecture
- #3909 — same-artifact PROJECT-DEFINITION locking (resolved)
